name: Band of Brothers
description: Drawn from interviews with survivors of Easy Company, as well as their journals and letters, Band of Brothers chronicles the experiences of these men from paratrooper training in Georgia through the end of the war. As an elite rifle company parachuting into Normandy early on D-Day morning, participants in the Battle of the Bulge, and witness to the horrors of war, the men of Easy knew extraordinary bravery and extraordinary fear - and became the stuff of legend. Based on Stephen E. Ambrose's acclaimed book of the same name.

videos.title: Premiere in Normandy
videos.overview: An HBO Entertainment News piece about the premiere of the mini-series in Normandy for Easy Company vets, their families, friends and stars of the series.

videos.title: Who's Who: The Men of Easy Company
The Making of "Band of Brothers"
videos.overview: Interviews made of the various actors and cast members that provide the knowledge and production skills and sets required to make the film a success.

videos.title: We Stand Alone Together: The Men of Easy Company
videos.overview: This companion documentary to HBO's acclaimed World War II miniseries “Band of Brothers” tells the story of Easy Company through recent interviews with some of the actual veterans. Combined with the words and memories of the former soldiers is rare and archival film footage and photos that bring to vivid life their incredible achievements.

videos.title: Ron Livingston's Video Diaries
videos.overview: Ron Livingston (Lewis Nixon) shot a 12 part video diary during the making of “Band of Brothers”.

videos.title: He Has Seen War
videos.overview: The surviving veterans and family members of Easy Company and the 1st Marine Division -- whose stories are shown in "Band of Brothers" and "The Pacific" -- discuss reintegrating into civilian life and the impacts the war had on them.

videos.title: Currahee
videos.overview: Easy Company is introduced to Captain Sobel, who has the group undergo hard and unfair training. As a result, Sobel comes into conflict with his men, including Richard Winters, his executive officer. The company is shipped to England to prepare for D-Day.

videos.title: Day of Days
videos.overview: Easy Company lands in Normandy, scattered all across and away from their drop zone. 1st Lt. Meehan, commander of Easy, is killed when his plane suffers a direct hit and 1st Lt. Winters must take command and 1st Lt. Speirs is introduced.

videos.title: Carentan
videos.overview: Easy Company are sent to liberate the French village of Carentan, where they lose several men in heavy fighting. The episode focuses on Private Albert Blithe, who struggles with crippling anxiety following the battle.

videos.title: Replacements
videos.overview: With the addition of many new men, Easy Company heads to Holland to participate in Operation Market Garden and prepare an Allied route into Germany, but they meet stiff German resistance.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: Winters writes a report on the challenge of an unexpected resistance to a German attack, and is haunted by his conscience after shooting a teenage German soldier. Operation Pegasus is depicted. Easy Company is called to Bastogne to repel the sudden German counterattack.

videos.title: Bastogne
videos.overview: Easy Company experiences the Battle of the Bulge and have to hold ground near Bastogne while running low on ammunition and other supplies. The episode focuses on medic Eugene "Doc" Roe as he helps out his fellow soldiers where he can, while also scrounging for medical supplies, of which the Company is dangerously low.

videos.title: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: Easy Company battles near Foy, Belgium, losing numerous men. In the episode, the actions of 1st Lt. Norman Dike, the Company's commander, are examined and questioned. Serving as narrator is 1st Sgt. Carwood Lipton, who attempts to keep the morale of the men up as they endure their trials in the forest near Foy.

videos.title: The Last Patrol
videos.overview: Easy Company is in Hagenau in Feburary, 1945, where they prepare for a night patrol mission to capture German prisoners. The patrol includes one veteran who is despised for missing Bastogne and a new lieutenant fresh out of West Point.

videos.title: Why We Fight
videos.overview: As the Allies move into Germany and the war comes closer to an end, disillusionment and anger set in for Easy Company--until they stumble onto a concentration camp abandoned by the German military.

videos.title: Points
videos.overview: As the Germans surrender, it appears that that the hard days for Easy Company are over as they are stationed in Austria. But they soon learn that those solders without enough service points will be sent to fight in Japan.

language: English, German, French, Dutch, Latin, Polish, Spanish
